latest_release.name: v1.0.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Initial documentation and validation workflow by @timheuer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/1
* Add skill for using file-based programs by @agocke in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/20
* Revise validation and reference for file-based apps by @DamianEdwards in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/24
* Restructure repo to use src/<component> layout by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/40
* Eval workflow structure by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/41
* docs: Add naming guidelines to CONTRIBUTING by @timheuer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/43
* Replace eval pipeline with skill-validator. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/44
* Use gh pr comment instead of third party dependency. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/45
* Bump node version to 22. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/46
* Update skill-validator ref to include CI auth fix by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/47
* Use correct token. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/48
* Update skill-validator ref with JSON serialization and mkdir fixes by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/49
* Change default runs to 5 for statistical significance by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/50
* Include hidden files for uploading results. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/55
* Update skill-validator version. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/56
* Add git remote origin when initializing gh-pages branch. by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/57
* fix: force array output in components.json for dashboard by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/59
* Add dotnet-msbuild component with skills, agents, and tests by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/42
* Disable cron for now by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/60
* Add dashboard badge by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/61
* Enhance README with new plugin and workflow sections by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/62
* Reduce quota in evaluation workflow by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/65
* Only evaluate changed components in PRs by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/66
* Add judge model input to evaluation workflow by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/67
* Add parallel runs support to skill-validator by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/68
* Enhance CONTRIBUTING.md with skill test guidelines by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/70
* Add copy_test_files support and clean up test metadata by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/69
* Re-enable cron and set to every two hours by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/71
* Add .NET P/Invoke skill by @AaronRobinsonMSFT in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/54
* PInvoke skill test *IGNORE THIS* by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/58
* Added C# MCP Server development skills by @leslierichardson95 in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/36
* Revert "Added C# MCP Server development skills" by @leslierichardson95 in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/74
* Scope PR evaluation to only changed skills by @adityamandaleeka in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/76
* [Infra] Add verbose logging for work directory in runAgent by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/93
* [Infra] Add run label to distinguish output by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/94
* [Infra] feat: add support for parallel scenarios in skill evaluation by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/skills/pull/84
* [Infra] Updates to eval pipeline and instructions by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dot
